text:
maria: New eu2 customer account onboarding — need infra input. Goal: Dedicated A100 pool across 3 AZs, PrivateLink to our shared-services hub, and AZ-local NAT egress. Unsure on subnet sizing, SNAT port limits, and public IP quota. Can infra help raise quotas and validate design?
ken: Pinging infra-bot and @samir for sizing + @priay for networking.
infra-bot: Support ticket created: AZ-PRJ-4721. Add quota details here and tag cloud-ops.
samir: Quick Q — how many A100s initially vs target? Pod density per node? That drives IP/ENI math.
maria: Starter commit is 8 A100 nodes (reserved) with ramp to 32 within 90 days. Expect ~2 inference pods per node on avg. Each node uses host-networking for GPU drivers + 1 ENI. Need spare IPs for kube-proxy, CNI, metrics sidecars. Want one NAT gateway per AZ for egress.
priya: Recommendation: allocate a /22 for the gpu-vnets and split into three /24s (one per AZ). That gives room for ENIs, scaling, and control plane. Also request public IP quota for 3 NAT gateways + 3 spare IPs for LB/frontends + 2 for marketplace image publish = ~12 public IPs.
alex: Note on SNAT: if we rely on a single public IP per NAT we’ll hit SNAT port exhaustion quickly. Use NAT Gateway with multiple public IPs per gateway. For 32 nodes and many outbound connections, plan for 3 NATs x 4 IPs = 12 IPs.
ken: Cost note for sales: NAT public IPs are charged per hour. If customer cares about cost we could reduce to 2 NATs with more IPs each, but that affects AZ-failover behavior.
samir: Draft quota text for cloud support (paste below).
maria: Copy/pasting the draft we want added to the support ticket:
```
Please increase the following quotas for account <redacted> in region eu2 to support dedicated A100 inference fleet and PrivateLink connectivity:
- GPU instances: NVIDIA A100 family (ND-series) -> increase quota to 32 instances (start 8, scale to 32)
- vCPU quota: increase to accommodate the above (please advise exact vCPU number required for ND-series)
- Public IP addresses: increase limit to 12 (for NAT gateways, load balancers, and spares)
- Virtual network/subnet IP quota: allow creation of one /22 network split into three /24 subnets; confirm no per-subnet IP cap will block 32 nodes + ENI overhead
- NAT Gateway limits / SNAT ports: enable support for multiple public IPs per NAT Gateway and confirm SNAT port headroom for 32 nodes with ~250 concurrent outbound connections per node
- PrivateLink / Private Endpoint quotas: enable creation of service endpoints and PrivateLink connections to the shared-services hub (allow cross-subscription PrivateLink)
Please assign to cloud-ops for quota increase and provide ETA. Contact: maria@redwood (alias).
```
infra-bot: Support ticket AZ-PRJ-4721 updated with the quota list and assigned to cloud-ops team (priority: high). Reference: cloud-ops/ev-993.
samir: Doing quick SNAT calc — 32 nodes * 250 concurrent ephemeral connections ~= 8k ports. Each public IP provides ~64k ephemeral ports, but with NAT mapping + connections per port we see exhaustion earlier. Recommend 12 public IPs (3 NATs x 4 IPs) or enable Azure NAT with TCP ephemeral port scaling. I'll add the calc to the ticket.
priya: Also request increase for NICs-per-vm and vm-scale-set quotas if applicable — some GPU SKUs have high NIC needs. Ask cloud support to confirm limits for the chosen ND SKU.
maria: Thanks all. I'll attach this thread to the ticket, include the customer's expected timeline (prod in 8 weeks), and loop in sales for cost estimate.
ken: LGTM — @samir can you drop the exact calc numbers into the ticket and then we'll request vendor approval?
samir: On it, will update by EOD.
infra-bot: Reminder: reopen if cloud asks for more info. :white_check_mark:
